title: InferSlice: A Reference Architecture for SLO-driven LLM Inference over a Telco Wide-Area Network
abstract: arXiv:2610.32638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM inference is increasingly deployed as a core service for enterprise and interactive applications, but sovereignty, compliance, latency and resource-locality requirements can limit the suitability of centralised cloud deployments. Telco operators offer geographically distributed compute and network infrastructure for addressing these constraints. However, existing LLM serving frameworks are designed for tightly coupled data centres and provide limited support for coordinating geographically distributed and heterogeneous resources. We present InferSlice, a reference architecture for Service-Level Objective (SLO)-driven LLM inference over a telco infrastructure, integrating network slicing, GPU partitioning, elastic serving and observability. translated_title: InferSlice：一种基于电信广域网的SLO驱动LLM推理参考架构
translated_abstract: LLM推理正日益被部署为企业级和交互式应用的核心服务，但主权、合规性、延迟和资源本地化要求可能限制了集中式云部署的适用性。电信运营商提供地理分布式的计算和网络基础设施，可用于应对这些限制。然而，现有的LLM服务框架是为紧耦合的数据中心设计的，对协调地理分布式和异构资源的支持有限。我们提出了InferSlice，一种在电信基础设施上实现服务水平目标（SLO）驱动的LLM推理的参考架构，集成了网络切片、GPU分区、弹性服务和可观测性。该项目由英国电信（BT）牵头，联合布里斯托大学和NVIDIA共同开展，并在JOINER英国国家级广域网（WAN）上实现，InferSlice在服务差异化方面进行了评估。
tldr: InferSlice是一个部署在电信广域网上的SLO驱动LLM推理参考架构，通过集成网络切片、GPU分区、弹性服务和可观测性，解决了集中式云部署难以满足的主权、合规、延迟和资源本地化需求。
en_tdlr: InferSlice is a reference architecture for SLO-driven LLM inference over telco wide-area networks, integrating network slicing, GPU partitioning, elastic serving, and observability to address sovereignty, compliance, latency, and resource-locality constraints of centralized cloud deployments.
